notes.title: GLOBAL UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1][b] Added: [/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*] Mechanics of daily tasks for which rewards in the form of resources are given for the farm.
[*] Optimization.
[*] A beautiful transition from calm mode to warrior mode and back.
[*] The system of blood from blows from enemies and animals.
[*] Training system for each element of game mechanics.
[*] Voice acting NPC in Russian and English.
[*] In the settings menu, you can change the audio volume.
[*] Second episode of the storyline.
[*] Cooldown time of abilities.
[*] Recharge time of blows.
[*] After the death of the player, the loading screen turns on to reload the world.
[*] Now all extracted resources will be shown in the lower right corner of the screen.
[*] Story missions: 1.
[*] Multiplayer and Singlplayer.
[*] A lot of beautiful calm music.
[*] Animation of saving the game.
[*] Steam Achievements.
[*] Ragdoll system (now mobs will realistically fall to the ground when they die).
[*] System of distribution of resources as a reward.
[*] Training with part of the storyline.
[*] Tasks and puzzles.
[*] Added treasury (now every minute different resources are added to the treasury depending on the population).
[*] Added a mechanic for randomly generated crates that need to be broken to get resources.
[*] Added farm mechanics in greenhouses (plantations need to be watered, and after harvesting these plantations, new seeds will need to be planted).
[*] Now cells with robots appear in the world randomly, which should be saved from the orcs.
[*] Added mechanics with mini-games.
[*] Added the mechanics of increasing the population in the game world.
[*] Added a mechanic in the open world for creating robots that walk around the area, from which you can fix the player and his things, also improve yourself
[*] Added the ability to quickly move around the map, if you open the points of movement.
[*] Ability to capture villages.
[*] Dynamic trail-effects of orcs.
[*] One episode of the storyline.
[*] Added a button to the menu, which kills the player at his will.
[*] Made an assistant for the main village.
[*] Voice acting NPC in Russian and English.
[*] In the settings menu, you can change the audio volume.
[*] Second episode of the storyline.
[*] Cooldown time of abilities.
[*] Recharge time of blows.
[*] After the death of the player, the loading screen turns on to reload the world.
[*] Now all extracted resources will be shown in the lower right corner of the screen.
[*] Story missions: 1.
[/list]
[h1][b] Changed: [/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*] The warrior controller is now fully functional.
[*] The system of using potions has become more understandable for players.
[*] The system of using food has become more understandable for players.
[*] The player's death system has become more understandable for players.
[*] The health restoration effects have been changed to more beautiful and dynamic ones.
[*] Player training has become clearer.
[*] The horse is now constantly running after the player.
[*] When completing quests, food will no longer be given to avoid a large amount of food for the player.
[*] Grass textures are now more beautiful.
[*] Lighting.
[*] Tags now have different colors, depending on their purpose.
[*] The radius of sound reproduction has become 10 times smaller.
[*] After the teleport, the loading screen turns on.
[*] Sounds of walking have become better.
[*] Now, when completing tasks that can be taken from villagers, players will receive rewards in the form of resources.
[*] Teleport to a large village is now more beautiful.
[*] The grass is now more beautiful.
[*] The wind became more intense.
[*] Icons for markers are now different for each target.
[*] Effects of points with interaction.
[*] Sounds of warrior strikes have been changed.
[*] The interface for sound settings has been changed.
[*] Shaders and textures for vegetation have been changed.
[*] Many resource textures and their shaders have been changed.
[*] The fence surrounding the villages has been removed for a more beautiful view of the open world and to optimize the game.
[*] The game has become more optimized.
[*] Changed textures under the feet, now the terrain has become more attractive.
[*] Orc damage has been cut.
[*] Orc trail effects have been changed. 
[*] The sounds got louder.
[*] The effect of loot boxes is now more beautiful.
[*] The mechanics of saving the entire process have been replaced with a newer one, so as not to occupy the registry of your system, but to save the entire game process in one separate file.
[*] The background in the main menu is now lively and beautiful.
[*] Player training has become clearer.
[*] The horse is now constantly running after the player.
[*] When completing quests, food will no longer be given to avoid a large amount of food for the player.
[*] Grass textures are now more beautiful.
[*] Lighting
[*] Tags now have different colors, depending on their purpose.
[*] The radius of sound reproduction has become 10 times smaller.
[*] After the teleport, the loading screen turns on.
[*] Sounds of walking have become better.
[*] Now, when completing tasks that can be taken from villagers, players will receive rewards in the form of resources.
[*] Teleport to a large village is now more beautiful.
[*] The grass is now more beautiful.
[*] The wind became more intense.
[*] Icons for markers are now different for each target.
[*] Effects of points with interaction.
[/list]
[h1][b] Fixed: [/b] [/h1]
[list]
[*] A save system that often did not load saved data.
[*] AI (Artificial Intelligence).
[*] A bug with the disappearance of game objects, mainly animals, if you approach them closely (about 10 meters).
[*] When opening the map, the labels floating around the screen will no longer interfere.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the sounds of footsteps were not played.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the icon for collecting resources from mobs appeared, but nothing could be collected.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which, after dying and choosing death (101) in warrior mode, and then switching to calm mode, the player teleported back to where he died.
[*] A bug due to which the player could lose a horse in the open world.
[*] A bug due to which it was impossible to use some teleports for fast travel.
[*] A bug due to which the character could spin while using a jumping ability, the effect of breaking the ground of which could also turn behind the player.
[*] A bug due to which the orcs restored health and became unkillable.
[*] Sounds that were not played now work properly.
[*] A bug due to which the sound of an orc screaming was constantly playing.
[*] And many other small bugs.
[*] A bug due to which the player could lose a horse in the open world.
[*] A bug due to which it was impossible to use some teleports for fast travel.
[*] A bug due to which the character could spin while using a jumping ability, the effect of breaking the ground of which could also turn behind the player.
[*] A bug due to which the orcs restored health and became unkillable.
[*] Sounds that were not played now work properly?
[*] A bug due to which the sound of an orc screaming was constantly playing.
[*] And many other small bugs.
[/list]
